**PAPI** is a menu-bar calculator and spreadsheet for macOS: type natural-language math (`bill increased by 18%`, `1250 usd to eur`, `next friday`) and get answers instantly, one shortcut away (default ⌥').

### Download

- **Apple Silicon (M1 and later):** [PAPI-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/cezarhere/papi/releases/latest/download/PAPI-arm64.dmg)
- **Intel:** [PAPI-x64.dmg](https://github.com/cezarhere/papi/releases/latest/download/PAPI-x64.dmg)

Not sure which? Apple menu → About This Mac: "Chip: Apple M…" is Apple Silicon, "Processor: Intel…" is Intel. Open the file and drag PAPI to Applications. Signed and notarized by Apple, so it opens without warnings. Already installed? PAPI updates itself: look for the banner in its window, or use **Check for Updates…** in the menu-bar menu.
